race.comment: Onto the Rupert Clarke and it looks a lovely race for LADY SHENANDOAH (6) to return to the winner's circle. She was very good fresh in the G1 Winx behind the absolute topliners. She's been very consistent but just racing in the best races and now back to a handicap, drawn for a soft trail, she gets her chance. Speaking of chances, ANGEL CAPITAL (5) has had plenty, a moral beaten in this race last year. He was very good fresh then the soft track apparently wasn't to his liking in the G1 Memsie. 56kg is very winnable on a rock-hard track but plenty will be sick of him by now. EVAPORATE (2) is flying, he was ridden a bit more quietly but won well last time. He's rock solid and this is his level, he'll just need a good ride from the draw. WARNIE (7) and PERSIAN SPIRIT (15) come through the Chautauqua Stakes, WARNIE was excellent from the back, PERSIAN SPIRIT was favourite there and looks a blowout chance down in the weights.
